# function: partnercentral_resource_snapshot

Builds the ARN for `partnercentral` `ResourceSnapshot`:

```
arn:${Partition}:partnercentral:${Region}:${Account}:catalog/${Catalog}/engagement/${EngagementIdentifier}/resource/${ResourceType}/${ResourceIdentifier}/template/${TemplateIdentifier}/resource-snapshot/${SnapshotRevision}
```

The partition, region and account fields come from the configuration file (`.arn.hcl`, or the path in `ARN_CONFIG`). The remaining placeholders are the arguments, in template order.



## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
partnercentral_resource_snapshot(catalog string, engagement_identifier string, resource_type string, resource_identifier string, template_identifier string, snapshot_revision string, options map of string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `catalog` (String) Value for `${Catalog}` in the ARN template.
1. `engagement_identifier` (String) Value for `${EngagementIdentifier}` in the ARN template.
1. `resource_type` (String) Value for `${ResourceType}` in the ARN template.
1. `resource_identifier` (String) Value for `${ResourceIdentifier}` in the ARN template.
1. `template_identifier` (String) Value for `${TemplateIdentifier}` in the ARN template.
1. `snapshot_revision` (String) Value for `${SnapshotRevision}` in the ARN template.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Map of String) Optional overrides: `account` (the name of an `account` block in the configuration file), `account_id` (a literal account id), `region` and `partition`. At most one options map may be given. An unrecognized key, or a value set to an empty string, is an error; omit an option, or set it to `null`, to use the default.
